info.title: Y API
info.description:
REST API for the Y anonymous mental-health community and personal wellness tracker.

All responses use the standard envelope (`success`, `message`, `data`, `meta` / `errors`).
Send `Accept-Language: ar` or `en` to localize messages. Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header.

post.summary: Report a post, comment or profile
post.description: Sends the item to the moderation queue. Priority comes from the reason (suicidal content / self-harm encouragement are critical). 201 when created; 200 with the existing report when you already have a pending report on the same item. 404 if you can't see the target (including content hidden by a block); 422 for your own content. The reported member is never told who reported them. `crisis_support: true` → show crisis resources and an escalation path.

get.description: Newest first. Only reports you filed.

post.description: Idempotent. 403 if the member doesn't accept followers (`follow_policy: nobody`). 404 for unknown/inactive profiles or when a block exists either way. 422 for yourself.

Idempotent. Removes follows in both directions. Afterwards neither member sees the other's posts, comments, profile or search results, and neither can interact with the other. Never reveals whether the other member blocked you. 422 for yourself.

get.description: Newest first. Only you can see this list. Skips inactive accounts and members hidden by a block.
Newest first. Only you can see this list.
Newest first, for the Blocked users screen.
Case-insensitive substring match (leading @ ignored), prefix matches first, up to 20 results. Never returns inactive accounts or members hidden by a block.
Substring match (leading # ignored), prefix matches first, then by number of public posts. Up to 20.
Top 10 by public posts in the last 7 days. Posts with a content warning never count (no amplification of sensitive content).

post.description: JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 8 MB. The image is re-encoded server-side: all metadata (EXIF GPS location, device, timestamps) is removed and it is downscaled to max 2048 px. Attach it via `media_ids` when creating/updating a post; unattached uploads are deleted after 24 h. 10 uploads/minute.

get.description: Public, visible, non-deleted posts, never from members hidden by a block either way. `popular`: last 7 days by engagement score and never includes posts with a content warning (no amplification of sensitive content). `following=true`: only members you follow. `q`: post text search.

parameters.name: following
parameters.description: Only posts from members you follow

get.description: 404 for deleted posts and for posts the viewer may not see (only-me, under review, hidden).

put.description: Author only (403 otherwise). Changing `content` marks the post edited. `media_ids` replaces the attached images.

delete.description: Author only. Removed from every endpoint immediately (retained server-side per retention policy).

get.description: Oldest first. A removed comment that still has visible replies appears as a placeholder (`is_removed`). 404 if the viewer may not see the post.

post.summary: Comment on a post or reply to a comment
post.description: 403 when the author turned comments off. 404 if the viewer may not see the post.

get.description: Oldest first. Also works under a removed placeholder. 404 for a reply (no deeper nesting) or a post the viewer may not see.

put.description: Author only: 403 for someone else's visible comment, 404 if the viewer may not see it.

delete.description: Author only. Replies stay visible under a placeholder.

post.description: One reaction per member per post; sending another type replaces it. 404 if the viewer may not see the post.

delete.description: Idempotent. 404 if the viewer may not see the post.

post.description: Idempotent. Saved posts are never shown to anyone else. 404 if the viewer may not see the post.

get.description: Most recently saved first. Posts that are no longer visible to you drop out.
On your own profile this also includes your only-me posts. Unknown or inactive members → 404.

get.summary: Your profile, preferences and privacy settings
get.description: Created automatically at registration (generated username + avatar). Contains no account credentials.

put.description: The first update marks profile setup as complete. After setup, the username can be changed once every 30 days (`username_change_available_at`); case-only changes are always allowed.
`language` is used for emails and push notifications; `timezone` (IANA) for local-time display and reminders.

profile_visibility.description: private = others see only username, avatar and joined date

get.summary: Check whether a username can be used
get.description: Your own current username counts as available. Limited to 30 checks/minute.
Case-insensitive. Unknown, suspended and deactivated accounts — and members who blocked you — all return 404. Never contains account identifiers.

post.description: On success every existing session is revoked. Invalid/expired token and unknown email return the same 422 (`errors.token`).
